# FabPosition

`Flare.Components.FabPosition`

Placement mode for a FlareFloatingActionButton.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BottomRight` | `0` | Anchored to the bottom-right corner of the viewport. The default. |
| `BottomLeft` | `1` | Anchored to the bottom-left corner of the viewport. |
| `Static` | `2` | Rendered inline in normal document flow (not anchored). |

## Used by components

- `FlareFloatingActionButton`
